meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把视频里的配乐与旁白混合好,做淡入淡出、音量自动压低与音效处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里的背景音乐盖住了人声,想快速把两条音轨混好。
copy.tagline_en: Mix music and voiceover in your video with fades, ducking, and track effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if background music drowns out the voiceover and you need them balanced.

howto.what: 当你已把音频放进 HyperFrames 工程,它会给这些音轨做混音:淡入淡出、交叉淡化、音量与自动化包络、人声出来时压住音乐的闪避,以及 EQ、压缩、限幅、混响等效果链。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 工程里音频已经放好、需要做混音时触发;找 BGM、音效或配音交给 /media-use,片段时序和轨道布局交给 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 让音乐轨在人声出现时做闪避
say.note: 对铺底音乐做 voiceover carve

say.text: 给这条音轨写淡入淡出和音量自动化
给对白轨加一条 EQ 加压缩的效果链

howto.what_en: Once audio is placed in a HyperFrames composition, Claude mixes it: fades and crossfades, track gain/volume, volume and effect automation, voiceover carve ducking, and effect chains like EQ, compressor, limiter, delay and reverb.
howto.when_en: Triggers when audio is already placed in a HyperFrames composition and needs mixing. Sourcing audio (BGM, SFX, voiceover) is /media-use; clip timing and track layout is /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Duck the music bed under the voiceover
say_en.note: Runs a voiceover carve on the bed

say_en.text: Write the fade-in and volume automation for this track
Add an EQ and compressor chain to the dialogue track
